translations.web: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.
translations.bsb: Women received back their dead, raised to life again. Others were tortured and refused their release, so that they might gain a better resurrection.
translations.kjv: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:
